title: A rep with no invoice of the chosen Sales Type leaves the report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have one split work order for that customer with Labor set to sales rep A and Parts set to sales rep B, invoiced today. Neither sales rep has other invoices today.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today, Show Unassigned on and the Sales Type column turned on.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Select only "Parts" in the Sales Type filter.
  2. Select only "Labor".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales rep A disappears (no blank row).
  • Sales rep B shows with the Parts row.

Step 2:

  • Sales rep A shows with the Labor row.
  • Sales rep B disappears.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R2: “Any combination can be selected. Rows, summary rows, totals and invoice counts follow the selection (S5-R10 to S5-R12).”

From: "SBR (Sales By Representative) Report" spec, Confluence 585629698, version 28 (12 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026

  • Sales By Representative spec, S5-R1: “A sales rep occupies a summary row if and only if they have at least one non-reversed invoice matching the current filter set (date range, sales type, invoice status, and location, together). Reps with no matching invoices do not appear — there is no blank placeholder row. A rep's current active/inactive (toggle) state does not affect whether they appear, only how they are labeled (S5-R9).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
